summary: This note is a short biographical sketch of Fred Dubois, covering his education at Yale College and his early career in business and public service in Illinois. It also notes his 1880 move to Idaho Territory with his brother, Dr. Jesse Dubois, Jr., a physician.
one_line: Biographical note on Fred Dubois, his Yale education, Illinois railroad commission post, and 1880 move to Idaho Territory.
key_facts: Fred Dubois studied at Yale College from 1870 to 1872.
Fred Dubois was elected to Scroll and Key while at Yale College.
After Yale, Fred Dubois participated in business until 1875.
In 1875, Fred Dubois was appointed to the board of railroad and warehouse commissioners of Illinois.
Fred Dubois held the Illinois railroad and warehouse commissioner position for one year.
Fred Dubois resigned from the Illinois railroad and warehouse commissioners board shortly before the death of his father.
In 1880, Fred Dubois moved to Idaho Territory.
Fred Dubois moved to Idaho Territory with his brother, Dr. Jesse Dubois, Jr.
Dr. Jesse Dubois, Jr. lived from 1850 to 1908.
Dr. Jesse Dubois, Jr. was a physician.
